composition.serve_who: This photo serves the vessel’s spare-parts inventory node because it documents two loose, packaged Harken needle roller bearings rather than an installed assembly. The label establishes manufacturer, part identity, dimensions, quantity, and order reference, but does not identify the specific Harken winch or other parent equipment; therefore the bearings must not be forced onto any individual winch node.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The items are photographed loose in a labelled parts bag and are not shown installed. The only supported attachment is the general spares node; although Harken winch nodes exist, the label gives no model, location, or equipment serial reference that links this bearing to a particular winch.
